name: Coat Number
description: Production speedup on subsequent coats. Coat 1 establishes the work and is the baseline. Coat 2 runs ~20% faster (rate x 1.20) because the painter follows existing laydown patterns and the surface is more uniform. Coat 3 (typically QT5) runs ~25% faster (rate x 1.25) because the surface is now fully built and even less wander/correction is needed. Stored as a TIME multiplier per engine convention (>=1 = slower; <1 = faster). FORWARD-LOOKING DECLARATION: engine wiring (db.factor_modifiers rows + ctx.coat_number population in context-adapter.js + multi-coat looper in spec-resolution.js) is a follow-up. Until wiring lands, modules carry modifier_eligibility.coat = true so the modifier fires automatically when the engine catches up. Replaces the inline `coat_2_rate_multiplier` field on individual tasks (retired 2026-05-05).
